{{Short description|Mathematics research paper series}}
'''Clay Mathematics Monographs''' is a series of expositions in [[mathematics]] co-published by [[American Mathematical Society|AMS]] and [[Clay Mathematics Institute]]. Each volume in the series offers an exposition of an active area of current research, provided by a group of mathematicians.
